evaluation.rationale: The hook is somewhat weak due to the slow setup in the first three seconds. The cliffhanger is strong as it leaves the audience questioning the identity of the men behind the ambush. Clarity is good, though the context might be lost on viewers unfamiliar with the series. The emotion is high due to the intensity of Alexander's rage and the revelation.
evaluation.hook_evidence: "Who?" Alexander turns away toward the frosted window, staring out into the dark raging blizzard outside.
evaluation.cliffhanger_evidence: Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, grim visage, his voice dropping to a deadly chill. 'The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.'
